newsitem.title: USA: LaserMaster sets $10 mln private placement.
newsitem.headline: LaserMaster sets $10 mln private placement.

text.p: LaserMaster Technologies Inc said Tuesday it has privately placed $10 million of its common stock and warrants to buy an equivalent number of shares with two companies.

The company said the shares were newly issued and placed at market rates. A spokesman declined to disclose the number of shares and warrants placed. In a statement, the company said the placement was done in an effort to address a current working capital shortfall.
The shares were sold to Sihl-Zurich Paper Mill on Sihl, a Zurich-based company, and TimeMaster, a company affiliated with LaserMaster's chief executive officer, LaserMaster said.

LaserMaster also said it had entered into an alliance with Sihl to promote the sales of wide-format media products and to develop new media products. LaserMaster markets printers and printing systems to publishing professionals.
